title: Converge presubmit profiles; add dependency-rotation agent and lightweight lint runner
author: Maya Patel
release_notes: Converged diverse presubmit profiles into a staged presubmit pipeline, introduced a dependency-rotation agent to proactively refresh low-risk transitive deps, added a lightweight lint runner to improve fast-feedback for small PRs. No runtime behavior changes.
body: Motivation: over time our presubmit lanes (fast, full, nightly) drifted into multiple duplicated YAMLs and ad-hoc scripts. That increases maintenance cost and makes fast-feedback inconsistent. This change consolidates presubmit profiles into a single staged-presubmit pipeline, introduces a dependency-rotation agent to automate low-risk transitive dependency bumps, and adds a lightweight lint runner that can execute in <30s for small changes. Goals: 1) Reduce presubmit configuration surface area, 2) Improve fast-feedback for small PRs, 3) Reduce manual churn from trivial dependency rotations.
